macos.name: Mac
macos.description: The Mac app is in private testing on Apple silicon. There is no Mac download yet; it will appear here when a build for testers is ready.
macos.details: There is no Mac download yet. The Mac app is in private testing on Apple silicon, and a build for testers is still being prepared.
checks: No Mac build is available to download yet.
The Mac app is not signed with an Apple Developer ID or notarized by Apple yet.
When a Mac build is listed here, it will show its version, SHA-256 checksum and signing status.

windows.name: Windows
windows.description: Version 0.6.39 is an unsigned pre-release for testers. Hands-on testing on Windows is still in progress, so expect rough edges.
windows.details: Version 0.6.39 is an unsigned pre-release for testers, built from the development line (commit a745087). It is not code-signed, and most of the Windows checklist has not been tested yet.
checks: Not code-signed: Windows SmartScreen will warn before it runs. README.txt in the download explains the warning.
On one Windows 11 PC with Smart App Control turned on, a downloaded copy passed its built-in self-check without being blocked. Other PCs may differ.
Live dictation into the Claude desktop app has been confirmed on Windows. Most other Windows checks (other apps, shortcuts, auto-send, wake, meetings) are still open.
Speech recognition runs on the processor for now. The speech model (about 670 MB) is downloaded separately, inside Hum.
